bagPolicy.summary: Nonclear bags up to 6 × 9 inches are allowed. Larger bags must be clear and no bigger than 12 × 12 × 6 inches; mesh does not count as clear, and medical or diaper bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Concert parking usually opens two to three hours before showtime; arrival and pass instructions depend on the ticket and lot. Parking spaces are first come first served within each lot.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: All rideshare and other passenger pickups and drop-offs use 11450 Maxwell Road, Alpharetta, GA 30009.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold onsite; most outside food is prohibited. Each guest may bring one empty refillable bottle or a sealed water bottle up to one gallon, and guests with medical or dietary needs may bring food in a clear one-gallon bag.
allowed: One empty refillable bottle or sealed bottle up to one gallon

accessibility.summary: Guest Services is at the East and West gates and can provide wheelchair rides to seats. Medical device bags are permitted after inspection.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry after leaving; returning requires a new ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens Fridays 10 a.m.–4 p.m., show days Monday–Saturday at 10 a.m., and Sunday show days at noon. The venue FAQ does not state a general will-call collection process.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Guest Services booths operate at the East and West gates. Concert-specific gate opening times are published close to the event on its Know Before You Go page.
